Torrent Power foresaw the prospects in the power sector much before the liberalization, when it took-over and successfully turned around an ailing power cable company Mahendra Electricals, renaming it as ‘Torrent Cables Ltd.’ (merged with Torrent Power Limited w.e.f. 1st April, 2014). Now, it is a separate business entity in the name of ‘Torrent Electricals Limited’. The high points of Torrent’s foray into power however were the acquisitions of two of the India’s oldest utilities – The Surat Electricity Company Ltd and The Ahmedabad Electricity Company Ltd. Torrent turned them into first rate power utilities, in terms of operational efficiencies and reliability of power supply.  Torrent ranks amongst the best run power utilities in the country with highly efficient generation assets. It has a portfolio of coal based, gas based and renewable power plants with an aggregate generation capacity of 4328 MW. The gas based plants of the Company possess greater environmental value with state of the art technology and in-built efficiency enhancing design features.  The Company distributes power to over 4.13 million customers annually in its distribution areas of Ahmedabad, Gandhinagar, Surat and Dahej SEZ and Dholera SIR (Gujarat), in Bhiwandi, Shil, Mumbra and Kalwa (Maharashtra), Agra (Uttar Pradesh) and in Union Territory of Dadra & Nagar Haveli, Daman and Diu. The T&D loss in license areas of the Company is amongst the lowest in the country. The Company offers highly personalized and innovative customer services that incorporate various convenience features.  Torrent Power created history by entering into the country’s first distribution franchisee agreement with Maharashtra State Electricity Distribution Company Limited for Bhiwandi Circle in December 2006. In 2009 it was awarded the distribution franchise for Agra in Uttar Pradesh. The significant reduction in AT&C losses in both Bhiwandi and Agra is a testimony of Company’s operational efficiency. During FY 19 the Company was awarded distribution license for Dholera Special Investment Region (Gujarat) and distribution franchise for Shil, Mumbra & Kalwa (SMK) area (Maharashtra).In FY 21 Torrent Power emerged as a successful bidder for 51% stake in licensed distribution operations in Union Territory of Dadra & Nagar Haveli, Daman and Diu.  From establishing a prominent presence in the generation sector through thermal and renewable generation - to creating a link to the distribution utilities through an effective transmission network - to reaching the end consumer with uninterrupted power supply and 24X7 customer care initiatives through its distribution network, Torrent Power has proven its mettle as an integrated power utility.  The Company is likewise committed to the cause of social service and is repeatedly channelizing a part of its resources and activities, such that it positively affects the society. As a part of its CSR initiatives, the Company makes concentrated efforts in the fields of Community Healthcare, Sanitation & Hygiene, Education & Knowledge Enhancement and Social Care & Concern. Since 1989, Torrent Electricals has been a trusted manufacturer of high-performance power cables, serving both private and public sectors. With years of expertise, the company has set new benchmarks in quality, reliability, and innovation. Backed by Torrent Powers leadership in transmission and distribution, every cable is engineered for safety, efficiency, and long-term performance.  A pioneer in the industry, Torrent Electricals was the first cable manufacturing company in India to achieve ISO 9001:2000 certification, reinforcing an unwavering commitment to quality. This dedication has shaped a brand that consistently adapts to market needs while maintaining the highest standards.  With a comprehensive portfolio, Torrent Electricals specializes in Extra High Voltage (EHV), High Tension (HT) XLPE, Low Tension (LT) XLPE/PVC Power Cables, Control Cables and Durable and high-quality wires for residential and commercial applications. Every product undergoes rigorous Routine, Type, Acceptance, and Special Tests, ensuring unmatched safety and durability.  Rooted in the core values of the Torrent Group for excellence, innovation, and transformation, Torrent Electricals continues to power industries, businesses, and homes with trusted electrical solutions.

As we operate with a compact team of up to eight employees, routine HR responsibilities will be relatively limited. Therefore, the major focus of this position will be on *Digital Marketing, Advertising, Sponsorship and Revenue Generation*, along with basic HR and administrative responsibilities.  The candidate should be comfortable working in a small, fast-moving media organisation and should have the ability to manage multiple responsibilities independently.  ## 1. Advertisement, Sponsorship & Business Development  A major responsibility of this position will be to generate *advertising and sponsorship revenue* for the companys publications, digital platforms, YouTube channels, events and special projects.  The candidate will be expected to: * Identify prospective advertisers, sponsors and corporate partners. * Build and maintain databases of potential clients across relevant business sectors. * Approach companies through telephone calls, emails, WhatsApp, LinkedIn, networking and personal meetings. * Generate leads and maintain regular follow-up until conversion. * Prepare and present Advertising Rate Cards, Media Kits, Sponsorship Proposals and Corporate Presentations. * Develop relationships with corporate houses, advertising agencies, media buying agencies and institutions. * Negotiate advertising and sponsorship packages and work towards achieving revenue targets. * Maintain long-term relationships with existing advertisers, sponsors and business partners.  ## 2. Global Gujarati Conference February 2027  One of our major upcoming projects is the *Global Gujarati Conference, being organised on **67–8 February 2027*. The conference aims to bring together Gujarati representatives living across *129 countries, with an expected participation of **more than 3,000 NRIs and overseas Gujaratis*. This major international gathering will create significant opportunities for companies and organisations wishing to connect with the global Gujarati and NRI community. The candidate will play an important role in developing *advertising, sponsorship and corporate partnerships* for this conference.  Responsibilities will include: * Identifying potential Conference Sponsors and Corporate Partners. * Approaching companies whose products and services are relevant to NRIs and overseas Gujaratis. * Developing different levels of sponsorship and advertising packages. * Coordinating meetings and presentations with potential sponsors. * Following up with corporate decision-makers and converting opportunities into confirmed business. * Maintaining systematic records of leads, proposals, negotiations and confirmed sponsorships.  ## 3. Special NRI-Focused Magazines & Publications  In connection with the Global Gujarati Conference, we plan to publish a series of *Special Magazines / Special Editions* covering sectors that are particularly relevant to NRIs, overseas Gujaratis and global investors. These may include: * Real Estate & Property * Banking, Finance & Investment * Wealth Management * Medical Tourism & Healthcare * Insurance * Immigration & Visa Services * Education & Overseas Education * Hotels, Resorts & Hospitality * Travel & Tourism * Gems & Jewellery * Apparel & Lifestyle * Automobile * Technology & Digital Services * Export-Import & International Business * Government Departments, Boards & Corporations * NRI Services * Other sectors relevant to the Global Gujarati community The candidate will be responsible for generating *advertisements, advertorials, sponsorships and corporate partnerships* for these special publications.  Potential advertisers may include Real Estate Developers, Banks, Financial Institutions, Investment Companies, Hospitals, Healthcare Groups, Universities, Hotels, Resorts, Immigration Consultants, Jewellery Brands, Export Houses and other relevant organisations. The candidate should be able to offer advertising options such as *Full Page, Half Page, Premium Position, Advertorial, Special Feature and customised corporate packages*.  ## 4. Global Gujarati & Newi Svar YouTube Channels  The candidate will also be responsible for developing advertising and sponsorship opportunities for our *Global Gujarati* and *Newi Svar* YouTube channels. Responsibilities will include: * Identifying advertisers and sponsors suitable for the audience of both channels. * Developing sponsorship opportunities for interviews, special programmes, video series and other content. * Generating Corporate Advertisements and Branded Content opportunities. * Developing sponsorship packages for special interview series and event-related videos. * Building long-term relationships with brands that wish to reach Gujarati audiences in India and abroad. A key objective will be to create *360-degree Integrated Media Packages* combining: *Special Magazines + YouTube Channels + Social Media + Conference Branding + Event Sponsorship* For example, a Real Estate Developer, Bank, Hospital or Investment Company could be offered an integrated package providing visibility through a Special Magazine, YouTube content, Social Media and the Global Gujarati Conference.  ## 5. Digital Marketing & Social Media  Digital Marketing will be another major responsibility of this position. The candidate will: * Manage and promote content across *YouTube, Facebook, Instagram and other digital platforms*. * Plan digital promotion for videos, interviews, reels, shorts and social media posts. * Handle YouTube titles, descriptions, keywords, tags and basic SEO. * Schedule and publish social media content. * Develop strategies to increase reach, views, subscribers, followers and audience engagement. * Support or manage paid campaigns on Google, YouTube, Facebook and Instagram whenever required. * Use Analytics and Insights to monitor content and campaign performance. * Identify emerging digital trends and promotional opportunities. * Coordinate with content creators, designers and video editors. * Support WhatsApp and Email Marketing campaigns. * Develop and execute digital campaigns for the *Global Gujarati Conference and Special NRI Publications*. * Strengthen the overall digital visibility of RAA Positive Media, Global Gujarati and Newi Svar.  ## 6. HR Responsibilities  As the company plans to maintain a small team of up to eight employees, HR responsibilities will be limited but important. The candidate will: * Coordinate recruitment whenever new team members are required. * Screen CVs and coordinate interviews. * Handle joining and basic onboarding formalities. * Maintain attendance, leave and basic employee records. * Maintain necessary HR documentation. * Coordinate between employees and management. * Support office discipline and a positive working environment. * Maintain confidentiality of employee and company information.  ## 7. Administration & Coordination  The candidate will also assist in routine office administration, including: * Day-to-day office coordination. * Meetings, appointments and visitor coordination. * Vendor and purchase coordination. * Office stationery and basic maintenance requirements. * Maintaining documents, records and correspondence. * Supporting management in routine operational activities. * Providing administrative and coordination support for conferences, publications, interviews, events and other media projects.  ## Qualification & Experience  * Graduate / Postgraduate preferred. * Candidates with experience in *Digital Marketing, Media Marketing, Advertising Sales, Sponsorship, Business Development or Corporate Sales* will be given preference. * Experience in media, publishing, events, advertising or digital platforms will be an added advantage. * Practical knowledge of YouTube, Facebook, Instagram, Canva, Meta Business Suite, basic SEO, Google tools, MS Office and Excel is desirable. * Good communication skills in *Gujarati, Hindi and English* are preferred. * The candidate should be comfortable communicating with senior executives, corporate clients, advertisers and sponsors.  ## Key Skills  The ideal candidate should possess: * Excellent communication and presentation skills * Advertising and sponsorship sales ability * Lead generation and strong follow-up skills * Corporate networking ability * Negotiation and deal-closing skills * Digital Marketing and Social Media knowledge * Creativity and business-oriented thinking * Good organisational and coordination skills * Ability to multitask * Self-motivation and ownership * Target-oriented and result-driven approach  ## Ideal Candidate Profile  We are *not looking for a conventional HR Executive alone*. We are looking for a *smart, energetic, digitally active and business-minded professional* who is comfortable taking multiple responsibilities in a small and dynamic media organisation.  The candidate should have a strong interest in *Media, Digital Marketing, Advertising, Sponsorship and Business Development* and should be capable of contributing directly to both *Brand Visibility and Revenue Generation*. Candidates with the ability to independently identify advertisers, approach corporate clients, make presentations, conduct consistent follow-ups and convert opportunities into advertising or sponsorship business will be particularly preferred.  ## Approximate Role Allocation  *Advertisement, Sponsorship & Business Development – 35%* *Digital Marketing & Social Media – 35%* *HR – 15%* *Administration & Coordination – 15%* The allocation may vary depending on the company’s requirements, particularly during the preparation period for the *Global Gujarati Conference – 6–7–8 February 2027*.  ### Our Objective  The person joining us should become an important link between our *media platforms, Global Gujarati initiatives, corporate advertisers, sponsors and audiences in India and across the world*. The role offers an opportunity to work on a unique international Gujarati platform while contributing to the growth of *RAA Positive Media, Newi Svar, Global Gujarati, Special NRI Publications and the Global Gujarati Conference

Define instruments, universe, observation frequency, signals, entry and exit conditions, filters, holding period, position sizing and risk controls. Explain the reasoning behind the universe, including instruments deliberately excluded and why. • Investigate market and instrument mechanics. Write, inspect and debug this code independently. • Work carefully with financial time-series data. Handle identifiers, timestamps, timezones, differing frequencies and datasets from multiple sources. Investigate missing observations, inconsistent prices, corporate-action adjustments and other data issues before relying on any result. • Evaluate results critically. Examine performance across time periods, instruments and market conditions. Investigate drawdowns, turnover, concentration, trade counts, parameter sensitivity and the effect of realistic trading costs and assumptions. Distinguish a genuine effect from one produced by the testing process itself. • Keep exploration separate from evaluation. Reserve data that has not been used to select the model or its parameters, and be able to state what a given result does and does not demonstrate. • Take promising strategies towards implementation. Specify data requirements, validate signals and calculations against the production data layer, and support the work required to move a strategy into the live framework. • Analyse live and paper performance. Where a strategy has been deployed, compare its behaviour against the backtest and help establish whether differences arise from data issues, implementation differences, execution effects or a change in the underlying opportunity.  • Maintain clear records of your research. Finishing Works Supervise and control finishing activities including: - Flooring and stone works - Internal and external plaster - Waterproofing - False ceiling coordination - Doors and windows - Painting - Bathrooms and wet areas - Balconies and terraces - Faade-related civil interfaces - Common areas, lobbies and staircases Maintain high finishing standards appropriate for a premium residential project.  3. Site & Contractor Management - Manage and coordinate civil contractors, subcontractors and site supervisors. - Allocate work fronts and ensure adequate manpower, machinery and materials are available. - Monitor contractor productivity and identify delays or underperformance. - Conduct daily site inspections and progress reviews. - Ensure contractors rectify defective or incomplete work promptly. - Verify contractor measurements and quantities before certification.  4. Drawing & Technical Coordination - Review architectural, structural and relevant MEP drawings before execution. - Identify drawing discrepancies and constructability issues before work begins. - Raise RFIs and coordinate resolutions with architects, structural consultants and other consultants. - Ensure only the latest approved drawings are being used at site. - Coordinate civil openings, shafts, sleeves, embeds and other MEP requirements before concreting or finishing.  5. Quality Control - Ensure all work complies with approved drawings, specifications, IS codes and project quality standards. - Carry out pre-pour inspections and construction checklists. - Monitor concrete quality, cube testing and other required material tests. - Inspect reinforcement, shuttering, waterproofing, masonry and finishing works. - Maintain inspection and quality records. - Identify defective workmanship and ensure corrective action before subsequent work proceeds. - Minimise rework through proper supervision and planning.  6. Planning & Progress Monitoring - Work with the Project Manager and planning team to achieve project milestones. - Prepare short-term execution plans and weekly work targets. - Monitor actual progress against planned progress. - Identify potential delays in advance and recommend corrective actions. - Coordinate upcoming material, manpower, drawing and equipment requirements. - Maintain daily and weekly progress records.  7. Material Management - Estimate short-term material requirements based on planned activities. - Coordinate with procurement and stores to ensure uninterrupted availability. - Check incoming materials against approved specifications. - Monitor consumption and minimise material wastage. - Report abnormal consumption, shortages or misuse.  8. MEP & INTERDISCIPLINARY COORDINATION Coordinate closely with electrical, plumbing, fire-fighting, HVAC, lift and other specialist teams to ensure: - Required openings and sleeves are provided correctly. - Civil and MEP activities are properly sequenced. - Services do not conflict with structural or architectural elements. - Finished civil work is not unnecessarily damaged for subsequent MEP installation.  9. Safety & Site Discipline - Ensure contractors follow project safety requirements. - Coordinate with the safety team before high-risk activities. - Maintain proper housekeeping and safe access throughout assigned areas. - Stop or escalate unsafe construction practices when required.  10. KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS  Performance will primarily be measured on: Quality of Work | Schedule Achievement | Rework Control | Contractor Productivity | Material Wastage | Snag Closure | Safety Compliance | Handover Readiness  IDEAL CANDIDATE  We are looking for someone who is site-oriented rather than purely office-oriented. Two things make this design job different from most. Your user is interrupted. A dental receptionist uses our software with a patient at the counter, a phone ringing, and a hygienist waiting on an answer. Designs that assume focus, patience, or a second attempt will fail in that room. Speed, recoverability, and glanceability beat elegance every time. Two audiences, one product. Practice staff use the admin side daily and will learn it. Patients touch the booking and forms flow once, on a phone, possibly in a car park, and will abandon it if it asks too much. The same feature often needs both, designed to different rules. What you ll do - Own design for the Patient Engagement squad end to end - flows, interaction, and interface, from rough concept through shipped detail. - Work with the Product Owner from the start of a problem rather than at the end. Design that begins after the story is written is decoration. - Build and extend our design system so patterns stay consistent across a product that has grown fast and in several directions. - Design for the constraints that come with integrations - data we don t control, states we can t predict, and errors that originate in someone else s system. - Do the research available to you: usability sessions during overlap hours, session and support evidence, and time with our customer success and training teams, who watch practices struggle daily. - Design the empty, loading, error, and edge states. In a product used under pressure these matter more than the happy path. - Prototype enough to test a question, not to decorate a decision. - Hold a line on accessibility - our patient-facing flows are used by every age group, on every device, often in poor conditions. jd_text: B2B Growth Agency | Australian & New Zealand Clients | Remote  Brighta Group is an Australian B2B growth agency helping ambitious businesses turn strategy, brand, digital marketing, websites and CRM into measurable commercial growth.  We are looking for an experienced Head of Digital Performance / Digital Team Leader to take ownership of our Digital Business Unit and lead the performance of our SEO, Google Ads and digital marketing team.  This is not a role for someone who simply manages tasks, prepares reports or waits for clients to tell them what to do.  We need a commercially minded digital leader who asks: What commercial result is the client trying to achieve and is our digital strategy actually helping them achieve it?  The Role You will be accountable for the performance, quality and commercial effectiveness of Brighta's digital marketing delivery across our portfolio of predominantly B2B clients in Australia and New Zealand. You will lead digital specialists, review campaign performance, challenge underperformance, identify opportunities and ensure our team is proactively recommending what needs to happen next. Your success will not be judged by how busy the team is. It will be judged by whether: - campaigns are delivering measurable commercial outcomes; - client digital strategies are improving; - problems are identified before the client identifies them; - specialists are being properly challenged and developed; - work is completed accurately and on time; - clients understand what is working, what isn't and what we are doing about it; and - Brighta is retaining and growing successful client relationships.  What You Will Own 1. Digital Performance Take ownership of performance across: - Google Ads / Paid Search - SEO - Local SEO / Google Business Profile - Conversion optimisation - Landing pages - Website performance - Lead generation - Analytics and tracking - GA4 and Google Tag Manager - Search Console - Looker Studio / reporting - Marketing attribution You do not need to personally execute every campaign, but you must be technically strong enough to audit the work, challenge specialists and know when something isn't right.  2. Commercial Outcomes We are not interested in reporting impressions, clicks and rankings without explaining what they mean commercially. You must be able to connect digital activity to: Traffic Leads Qualified Opportunities Pipeline Revenue You will regularly ask: - Are we targeting the right audience? - Is the traffic commercially relevant? - Are leads converting? - What is the cost per qualified opportunity? - Where are leads dropping out? - Is tracking accurate? - What should we stop doing? - What should we test next? - Where can we create a better commercial result for the client?  3. Digital Team Leadership You will lead and hold accountable our digital specialists. This includes: - Setting clear expectations and priorities - Reviewing campaign strategy and execution - Conducting regular performance reviews - Coaching and developing specialists - Identifying capability gaps - Improving processes and standards - Ensuring deadlines are met - Maintaining accurate task and time tracking - Escalating risks quickly - Preventing recurring mistakes We expect a leader who raises standards rather than accepts excuses.  4. Client Strategy You will work closely with our Client Services team to provide senior digital thinking for clients. You must be comfortable: - joining client strategy meetings; - explaining complex digital issues simply; - challenging assumptions professionally; - recommending changes based on evidence; - presenting performance clearly; - discussing commercial objectives with business owners and senior managers; and - taking ownership when results are off-track. Our clients are predominantly B2B businesses, so strong B2B marketing experience is highly desirable.  Who We Are Looking For You will probably have 7+ years of digital marketing experience, including meaningful experience leading specialists, campaigns or a digital team. Agency experience is strongly preferred. You should have strong working knowledge across: - Google Ads - SEO - GA4 - Google Tag Manager - Google Search Console - Conversion optimisation - Landing pages - Lead generation - Marketing funnels - Reporting and attribution But technical knowledge alone will not make you successful at Brighta. We are specifically looking for someone with a:  Commercial Mindset You understand that marketing exists to help a business grow. You can look beyond campaign metrics and understand: - the client's business model; - their target market; - lead quality; - sales conversion; - customer acquisition economics; - revenue objectives; and - where marketing can create the greatest commercial impact.  The Person We Want You are likely to be someone who: - Takes ownership without needing constant supervision - Challenges poor performance rather than explaining it away - Identifies problems early - Is naturally curious about why something is or isn't working - Makes decisions based on data - Communicates clearly and confidently - Is comfortable challenging senior people respectfully - Sets high standards for yourself and others - Is organised and disciplined - Follows through on commitments - Moves quickly when something needs fixing - Understands that accountability comes with leadership  You must have excellent spoken and written English and be comfortable communicating regularly with Australian and New Zealand clients.  This Role Is Probably NOT For You If: - You prefer being given detailed instructions before taking action - You primarily measure success through tasks completed - You avoid difficult conversations - You wait until monthly reporting to identify campaign problems - You rely completely on specialists to tell you whether their work is good - You are uncomfortable being accountable for results - Your experience is primarily B2C/eCommerce with limited understanding of B2B lead generation - You believe good reporting can compensate for poor commercial outcomes  Working With Brighta Brighta operates with clients primarily across Australia and New Zealand. This is a full-time remote role based in India, and you must be able to work sufficient crossover hours with the Australian business day for leadership, team and client meetings. We are building a high-performance team and are looking for people who want significant responsibility, accountability and the opportunity to grow with the business.  Application Process We deliberately do not hire based on CVs alone. If you want to be considered, please submit your CV and complete the following application requirements.  Step 1 Video Introduction Record a video answering: - Tell us briefly about your experience leading digital marketing teams. - Tell us about a B2B campaign that was underperforming. What was wrong, what did you change and what commercial result followed? - A Google Ads specialist tells you a campaign is performing well because CTR and conversion rate have increased. What additional questions would you ask before agreeing? - What does being commercially minded mean to you as a Head of Digital? - Tell us about a time you had to challenge either a team member or client because you believed their approach was wrong.  Step 2 Shortlisted Interview Shortlisted candidates will complete a structured leadership and technical interview.  Step 3 Digital Account Challenge Final candidates may be provided with a sample digital account and asked to identify: - what they believe is wrong; - what they would investigate; - what they would prioritise; - what they would tell the client; and - what they would expect the team to do next.  Think You Can Raise the Standard? If you are an experienced digital leader who understands that great digital marketing is measured by business outcomes rather than activity, we'd like to hear from you. Apply with your CV and video introduction.
